page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It does not feature any integrated GPU hardware accelerators, nor does it include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and low memory-to-core ratio, the ecs.c2.medium is designed for compute-bound workloads that do not require large memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, high-performance computing tasks, CPU-intensive web serving, and distributed analytics where memory usage is predictable and low.
